text: Range is open. Ear-stuffing's in the bucket.
Steady hands make full purses. Care to try?
Mind the line, {player}.
Sharpshooter! I've pinned your score on the board.
You've got a shooter's squint. Let's see it in action.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.
Targets pop up downrange. Further off pays more, and dropping them quick pays a bonus.
Sixty seconds. Hit a hundred and you've earned the title.
Pistol's quick. Musket reaches. Blunderbuss sprays. Double-barrel gives you two before the reload.
The hand cannon? Bursts where it lands. Knocks you back a step. Don't fire it indoors.
Fire when ready!
